text:
Core tradeoff
Respiration is high yield; fermentation is lower yield but can be the shorter, faster pathway under high glycolytic supply.
textPreview: Core tradeoff | Respiration is high yield; fermentation is lower yield but can be the shorter, faster pathway under high glycolytic supply.

name: Content-Placeholder-9-6
text:
Batch sequence
Glucose drawdown, ethanol overflow, diauxic transition, ethanol use, stationary phase, then loss of viability.
textPreview: Batch sequence | Glucose drawdown, ethanol overflow, diauxic transition, ethanol use, stationary phase, then loss of viability.

name: Content-Placeholder-10-7

Modeling task
Represent both the fast overflow decision and the slower regulatory return to respiratory metabolism.
textPreview: Modeling task | Represent both the fast overflow decision and the slower regulatory return to respiratory metabolism.

Keep the biology simple: the deck asks what mechanism can make fermentation rational under oxygen availability.

text:
Pathway economics
Ohm's-law returns compare fermentation and respiration as yield divided by effective resistance.

name: Content-Placeholder-9-6
text:
Softmax splitter
Pathway scores U_F and U_R become allocation weights theta_F and theta_R, with finite regulatory lag.
textPreview: Softmax splitter | Pathway scores U_F and U_R become allocation weights theta_F and theta_R, with finite regulatory lag.

name: Content-Placeholder-10-7
text:
Second substrate
Ethanol is both product and substrate: glucose represses ethanol uptake until the diauxic phase.
textPreview: Second substrate | Ethanol is both product and substrate: glucose represses ethanol uptake until the diauxic phase.

name: pathway-scores-body
text:
Pi_F = Y_ATP,F/(1/f_G + r_F)

Pi_R = Y_ATP,R/(1/f_G + r_TCA + r_ETC + 1/f_O2)

U_F = beta Pi_F + beta_a ln(a_G/a_C)
U_R = beta Pi_R

name: allocation-rule-title
text: Softmax allocation
textPreview: Softmax allocation

name: allocation-rule-body
text:
theta_i* = exp(U_i) / [exp(U_F)+exp(U_R)]

theta_F* = 1 / [1 + exp(-(U_F - U_R))]

dtheta_F/dt = (theta_F* - theta_F)/tau_reg
